payload.description:
**Blocked by:** ceilings, and the rule and approval identity work.

An action exceeding the requester's ceiling routes to the nearest member whose ceiling covers it. docs/APPROVAL.md records that v1 has no completable path while nobody is at a screen, and that presence is guaranteed only for a human in the web tab. In an organization presence is a team property, so human_takeover and immutable_approval can be satisfied by any member with standing. Revisit whether approval_fatigue can stay in V1_POLICY_EXCLUSIONS once five people share one bot.
payload.title: Escalate an approval to someone who can give it
